purpose: Teach: 講和/反米/布告/監禁/仮処分/歪曲/流布/招集

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、係争の講和的解決を目指せ
lines.en: Our company aims to resolve this dispute through peaceful negotiation.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear articulation on key terms. Steady gaze downward at documents before lifting. Tone of settled conviction, not debate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。反米感情の影響を市場分析で考慮します
lines.en: Understood. I'll factor in the impact of anti-American sentiment in the market analysis.
lines.style: Professional, note-taking cadence. Slight pause after the confirmation, absorbing the directive. Even delivery, no flourish. The voice of someone documenting carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新事業を公式に布告しろ
lines.en: Issue an official announcement about the new business venture.
lines.style: Direct, clipped. Minimal breath between sentences. Sharp attack on the opening word. This is a command, not a request. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の不当監禁事例には抗議します
lines.en: Understood. I'll file a formal protest regarding the illegal detention case affecting our staff.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. Each clause marked with slight weight. The tone of someone covering bases thoroughly. Professional but with quiet urgency underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の妨害には仮処分を申請しろ
lines.en: Apply for a preliminary injunction to counter the competitor's interference.
lines.style: Crisp, legal-register precision. No softening. Each action verb lands clearly. The voice of someone accustomed to being obeyed. Low, steady pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。製品評価の歪曲報道に対応します
lines.en: Understood. I'll respond to the distorted reporting on our product evaluation.
lines.style: Steady professional tone with controlled undertone of concern. Acknowledgment first, then commitment. Voice remains level but shoulders slightly tighter.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、誤情報の流布元を特定しろ
lines.en: Identify the sources spreading this misinformation about our company.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Sharp consonants on key words. No theatricality—this is urgent business delivered without drama. Eyes narrowing slightly with focus.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時の役員招集体制を整えております
lines.en: Understood. We've prepared the emergency executive assembly protocol and it's ready to activate.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly longer held notes. Professional satisfaction of preparation complete. Slight rise at the end indicating readiness. Formal but warm undertone—the work is done.
